messages:
Zoe H: Dry-run notes after today's rehearsal. Key items: finalize demo knob labels for slide deck, add QR signup fallback for mobile viewers, and confirm AE escalation path.

Ravi K: Good catch on QR. I generated a short URL + QR that points to the signup with utm=webinar_apr2026_qr: https://rwd.io/w/apr_qr (QR PNG uploaded to drive).

Mel B: AE escalation: recommend DM to the oncall AE and post to #sales-hot-leads when >=5 signups in rolling 8m. Also send an immediate webhook to HubSpot to create a task w/ tag webinar_apr_qr.

Aria P: Demo knobs we will expose live: batch_size, kv_cache (on/off), quant_profile. Slide copy needs small explainer text for each so audience understands the tradeoffs.

Zoe H: Slide update: I changed slide 6 to "Live knobs" and added the short defs. Please review: https://drive.redwood/slides/apr-26-live-knobs.

Ravi K: Ops one-liner to flip to recorded clip (place in runbook and pin):
```bash
# flip to recorded fallback clip
curl -s -X POST https://internal-api.redwood/v1/demo/override \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $OP_KEY" \
  -d '{"mode":"recorded","url":"https://video.redwood/fallbacks/short_qr_demo.mp4","note":"webinar_failover"}'
```

Mel B: For lead routing, Webhook endpoint tested -> https://hooks.example.com/inbound/apr_qr. Oncall AE DM mapping confirmed. Also added escalation: if >12 signups in 15m, page @growth-lead.

Aria P: Rehearsal action: run the long-tail prompts and then flip quant_profile to q8 mid-demo to showcase latency/cost delta. Capture metrics on the token dashboard.

OncallSalesBot: [automated] webhook status OK, sample delivery successful.

Zoe H: Also note timezone reach: half of registrants are APAC. We need a follow-up email scheduled for 02:00 UTC to hit AM in APAC with localized CTA. Maya, can you do email scheduling?

Aria P: I will coordinate with Maya on the localized follow-up. Also adding a short canned line for presenters on hallucinations: "Were moving to a safe demo and will share the recording while we investigate."

Ravi K: I added a tiny automation: if someone signs up via the QR, add source=qr_card and send a Slack DM to the AE owner for that region.

Mel B: Final checklist: pin runbook with ops snippets, QR assets, webhook mapping, slide deck changes, and attendee timezone follow-ups. Preflight 09:50 PT in #marketing tomorrow.

Zoe H: Thanks team. Please ack availability for preflight.

Ravi K: Confirmed.

Mel B: Confirmed.

Aria P: Confirmed.
